question: What was settled revenue in January 2026?

input.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(p.amount) as total_settled_amount,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) as total_refunds,
  SUM(p.amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) as net_settled_amount
FROM payments p
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id
WHERE p.status = 'settled'
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_date) = '2026-01-01'

SELECT 
  SUM(p.amount) as settled_payment_amount,
  SUM(o.discount_amount) as order_discounts,
  SUM(p.amount) - SUM(o.discount_amount) as net_revenue
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id
WHERE p.status = 'settled'
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_date) = '2026-01-01'
  AND r.refund_id IS NULL  -- exclude refunded payments

question: What was settled revenue in Q2 2026?

input.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE 
    WHEN p.status = 'settled' THEN p.amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
    ELSE 0
  END) AS settled_revenue_q2_2026
FROM payments p
LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id
WHERE p.payment_date >= '2026-04-01' 
  AND p.payment_date <= '2026-06-30'
  AND p.status = 'settled'
